resetPassword.done: ✅ Administrator password reset. Settings and data are unchanged.
resetPassword.generatedHint: (Randomly generated. Sign in now and change it under Profile.)
resetPassword.sessionsHint:
Note: web and app sign-ins that used the old password are signed out now. Web sessions issued before the last upgrade end after a restart (docker restart movieclaw).
      CLI and transcoder pairings are unaffected; the new password works without a restart.
resetPassword.description: Reset the movieclaw administrator password (for a forgotten password; no settings change)
resetPassword.showHelp: Only show the administrator username (if you forgot it too); changes nothing
resetPassword.passwordHelp: Set the new password directly (it stays in shell history; prefer the interactive prompt)
